Step 2 [PERFORMANCE]: Compress page images and convert to next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF) (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Optimize raw image assets using sharp, imagemin, or dynamic CDN image transforms to compress payloads and serve next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF).

Step 3 [PERFORMANCE]: Minify JavaScript assets to reduce payload size (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Integrate Terser, esbuild, or SWC into your production build pipeline to strip whitespace and shorten identifiers.

Step 4 [PERFORMANCE]: Defer or load render-blocking JavaScript asynchronously (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add the defer or async attribute to non-critical script tags in <head>, or convert scripts to type="module".

Step 5 [PERFORMANCE]: Extract critical CSS rules and defer non-critical styles (HARD | Est Time: 3 hours) - Inline critical above-the-fold CSS rules in a <style> block and load secondary stylesheets asynchronously with media="print" onload="this.media='all'".
Step 6 [SEO]: Structure the page with a primary H1 heading (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add one primary <h1> element containing the main headline of the page.

Step 7 [PERFORMANCE]: Reduce JavaScript not required during initial page load (HARD | Est Time: 4 hours) - Reduce JavaScript that is not required during initial page load: Defer non-critical interactive components and third-party scripts using dynamic import() route-based code splitting.
Step 8 [PERFORMANCE]: Minify CSS stylesheets to reduce weight (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Minify production CSS using clean-css, cssnano, or esbuild during compilation.
Step 9 [PERFORMANCE]: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 46 images that appear below the viewport fold.

Step 10 [PERFORMANCE]: Properly size images to match rendered display dimensions (MEDIUM | Est Time: 60 mins) - Resize source images or implement responsive srcset/sizes attributes so the browser downloads image assets tailored to the viewport resolution.

Step 11 [SEO]: Define an optimal HTML title element for search indexing (EASY | Est Time: 6 mins) - Define one page-specific <title> tag in the page <head> using the project's existing SEO configuration.
Step 12 [SEO]: Provide a valid, accessible sitemap.xml (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Ensure the sitemap endpoint responds reliably to HTTP requests without server errors or timeouts.

Step 13 [ACCESSIBILITY]: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~23 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.
Step 14 [ACCESSIBILITY]: Add a skip navigation link for keyboard users (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add an accessible skip link as the very first focusable element inside , e.g. Skip to main content.

Step 15 [SEO]: Avoid skipping heading levels in document outline (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Adjust heading levels so that <h2> is followed by the appropriate sequential level (e.g. <h3>) instead of jumping directly to <h5>.
Step 16 [SEO]: Provide essential Open Graph metadata for social sharing (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add the missing Open Graph tags (og:title, og:url, og:type) to your document <head>.

Step 17 [SEO]: Provide Twitter Card metadata for X / Twitter link previews (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> along with twitter:title and twitter:image to the document <head>.
